meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 装上后，当你给一个现成的访谈/播客视频提要求，Claude会先转录音频，然后为视频配上设计好的图形卡片（如标题、下方标注、引文、数据框、画中画），卡片内容与说话时间同步，原视频不变，最后输出带这些图形的MP4文件。
howto.when: 当你说出“graphic overlays”“on-screen graphics”等关键词，或要求给视频做图形包装时触发；纯字幕需求不会触发，会交给/hyperframes判断。

say.text: 把我的访谈视频加上开场标题和引文卡片。
say.note: 会按说话内容生成对应时长的图形。

say.text: 在视频里标出关键数据，用侧边栏展示。
say.note: 数据卡会同步到提到它的时候。

say.text: 做成竖屏9:16，用下三分之一标出人名职位。
say.note: 会调整画布并添加标注。

howto.what_en: Once installed, when you ask about an existing interview/podcast video, Claude transcribes the audio, then designs timed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, quotes, data callouts, PiP etc.) synced to speech, leaves the original clip untouched, and renders an MP4 with the overlays.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like 'graphic overlays' or 'on-screen graphics', or ask to package/dress up a video. Plain subtitles are excluded; unclear cases are routed to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add opening titles and quote cards to my interview video.
say_en.note: Generates cards timed to the speech.

say_en.text: Highlight key data in the video using a side panel.
Make it 9:16 portrait with lower-thirds for names and roles.
